decisions.decisionText: Sprint 196 closeout preserves three actual head roles without a self-hashing archive or relabeled capture. Freeze product/tooling implementation A after pre-freeze verifiers; assemble the measurement archive and run runtime154/release42 at A. Commit only the generated canonical runtime/release ledgers, explicit near.md documentation update and proof as B; run the one five-suite capture at clean B so it tests the shipped ledger state, then assemble the final proof-carry archive at clean B before importing capture output. The final archive serves the original A measurement ledger identity. Review evidence C may add narrowly named non-executable capture/CI/mover/final-archive outputs only. Producer and auditor independently compare A→B product paths, allowing only the two generated canonical ledgers plus explicit near.md; suite accounting keeps executionHead equal to the actual capture head B. No extra full capture or publication is authorized by this ordering.
